findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The fan guards of the cold room’s cooler were observed heavily accumulated with dust. The fans are above the table where food preparation occurs. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that fan guards are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent possible food contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Several bags of shredded lettuce stored in the salad cooler were tempting between 53F - 57F. PIC stated that the bags of lettuce were placed in the cooler the night before. The bags of lettuce were discarded by the PIC. Be sure that TCS food items are held at of 41F or less to ensure proper cold holding temperatures. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Juicer was observed to contain a build-up of dried food debris.  Discussed with PIC, juicer was cleaned on-site.  Ensure juicer is cleaned daily or after each use.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The top of the knife holder was observed to contain an accumulation of dust and food debris.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the knife holders are cleaned regularly.

4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Areas in need of re-caulking:
-hand sink
-3 part sink
-produce sink
Ensure sinks are caulked to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the fans in the walk in cooler and prep area to be soiled with dust and the area close to the vegetable sprayers to be soiled with mildew. Ensure these areas are cleaned more frequently so they are maintained clean. The manager stated he would have them cleaned. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
